mcd21-1.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

mcd21-2.flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

mcd21-3.flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

mcd21-4.flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

mcd21-5.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

mcd21-6.flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

mcd21-7.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

mcd21-8.flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

mcd21-9.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

mcd21-10.flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

mcd21-11.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

mcd21-12.flavorText: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

mcd21-13.flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

mcd21-14.flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

mcd21-15.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

attacks.name: Super Singe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

mcd21-16.flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

mcd21-17.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

attacks.name: Fury Strikes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

mcd21-18.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

mcd21-19.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

mcd21-20.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

mcd21-21.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

mcd21-22.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

mcd21-23.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

mcd21-24.flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

attacks.name: Meal Time
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, draw a card.

mcd21-25.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.
